title: Then there is prompt injection, a malicious email, ...: The Wild Wide West of OpenClaw Agentic System Security
abstract: arXiv:2610.35451v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-powered personal assistant frameworks such as OpenClaw combine LLM reasoning, persistent memory, tool invocation, local execution, and web-based workflows. These capabilities enable useful automation, but they also create security risks when untrusted inputs, model reasoning, tools, memory, and deployment configuration interact without explicit trust boundaries. This paper presents an empirical study of reported security concerns in OpenClaw using two complementary data sources: Reddit discussions and security-tagged GitHub issues. We analyze more than 25K Reddit posts from 13 OpenClaw-related subreddits and identify 162 security-relevant posts with 1,787 associated comments. We further collect 358 security-tagged GitHub issues and retain 180 issues describing concrete security concerns. translated_title: 《然后是提示注入、一封恶意邮件……：OpenClaw 智能体系统安全的蛮荒西部》
translated_abstract: 诸如 OpenClaw 这类由 AI 驱动的个人助理框架结合了大语言模型（LLM）推理、持久化记忆、工具调用、本地执行以及基于网页的工作流。这些能力带来了有用的自动化，但当不可信输入、模型推理、工具、记忆与部署配置在没有明确信任边界的情况下相互交互时，也会产生安全风险。本文利用两个互补的数据来源——Reddit 讨论和带有安全标签的 GitHub issue——对 OpenClaw 中被报告的安全问题进行了实证研究。我们分析了来自 13 个 OpenClaw 相关 subreddit 的超过 2.5 万条 Reddit 帖子，识别出 162 条与安全相关的帖子及 1,787 条关联评论；并进一步收集了 358 个带安全标签的 GitHub issue，保留了其中 180 个描述具体安全问题的 issue。通过定性分析和基于证据的 CWE 映射，我们共识别出 59 种不同弱点类型下的 521 个 CWE 实例，主要集中在访问控制（原文此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文通过对 Reddit 讨论与安全相关 GitHub issue 的大规模实证分析，系统刻画了 OpenClaw 智能体框架的安全现状，识别出 59 种弱点类型下的 521 个 CWE 实例，揭示了提示注入等风险在缺乏明确信任边界时对 LLM 智能体系统的普遍威胁。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically characterizes the security landscape of the OpenClaw agentic system by analyzing over 25K Reddit posts and security-tagged GitHub issues, identifying 521 CWE instances across 59 weakness types and exposing widespread risks—such as prompt injection—when LLM agents operate without explicit trust boundaries.
